summary: This document covers the CAPWAP binding for IEEE 802.11, which defines two MAC modes for wireless transmission points: Split MAC and Local MAC. It describes how the 802.11 MAC functions are divided between the access point and the controller in each mode.

eli5.summary: A wireless access point and its central controller must share the work. This describes two ways of dividing the jobs between them.

questions: capwap split mac vs local mac
